narrative_purpose: Opens the chapter on the lethal moment: a human with their mask knocked aside, going down in an air that looks rich and breathable but kills in seconds.
subject: A human in a worn field jacket sinking to their knees on the forest floor, one hand reaching back toward a dislodged exo-pack mask lying just out of reach, mouth open in a failing gasp. Bioluminescent spores drift past, indifferent. The air itself seems faintly, beautifully luminous.
scene: The floor of a glowing Pandoran forest at night, towering glowing trunks and hanging fronds around. A serene, almost lovely setting for a fast death; the beauty and the danger are the same air.
camera: Low cinematic angle near the forest floor, looking slightly up at the collapsing figure, the dropped mask sharp in the near foreground.
light: Cool bioluminescent glow from surrounding flora as key; a faint sickly teal-green cast in the air; deep shadow at the edges.
palette: Void-indigo and teal, cyan forest glow, a faint unsettling green haze in the air, one small warm amber glint on the dropped mask's lens.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate, hand-painted, atmospheric, NOT a 3D render or photo.
detail_level: Crisp on the figure and the dropped mask; softer glowing forest and drifting spores behind.
composition: Figure off-centre on a third line collapsing toward the mask in the foreground; glowing trunks framing; drifting spores leading the eye.
consistency_notes: Same exo-pack design as the cover (clear faceplate, side cartridge, jaw hose). Cool Pandora biolum palette; the air carries a faint green toxic cast unique to this figure.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no gore, no cartoon or anime style
